text: The Abu Dhabi Sports Council describes itself as the organiser of the UAE Tour and the UAE Tour Women: 'Abu Dhabi Sports Council, organisers of the UAE Tour and the UAE Tour Women, are pleased to confirm the full list of teams participating in the 2026 edition of both races' - 18 UCI WorldTeams plus 3 UCI ProTeams in the men's race (16-22 February) and 14 Women's WorldTeams, 3 Women's ProTeams and 3 Women's Continental Teams in the women's race (5-8 February).
short: ADSC organises the UAE Tour and UAE Tour Women

source.name: Abu Dhabi Sports Council press release - The teams of the 2026 edition of the UAE Tour and UAE Tour Women are announced
